turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
anceled within 1 hour of being placed.

You can cancel it on your order confirmation page, on the My Orders page in your Beekman 1802 account at https://beekman1802.com/account/login, or in the app. If the order is still within that 1 hour window, you’ll see a Cancel button there.

If more than 1 hour has passed, the order can no longer be canceled. In that case, you can refuse the package at delivery or at your local carrier facility for a refund. 💛
